text:
I walk slowly along the acacia path,

their snow petals perfume my hands,

my hair grows restless under a light zephyr

and the soul is like foam of aristocracies.


Good genius: this day you favor me,

hardly a sigh makes me eternal and brief...

Am I about to fly now that the soul moves?

Wings grow on my feet and the three Graces dance.


It is that last night your hands, in my hands of fire,

gave so many sweetnesses to my blood, that afterward,

my mouth filled with perfumed honeys.


So fresh that in the clean dawn of Summer

I greatly fear turning back running to the hamlet

with golden butterflies caught on my lips.

translation.title: I Walk Slowly Along the Acacia Path...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the classical lightness of Graces, zephyr, honey, and butterflies.
